property_summary: For every successful call to play() with msg.value equal to the required ticket price, the contract's pot after the call is congruent to 0 modulo gcd(TICKET_AMOUNT, FEE_AMOUNT) (i.e., pot % 1 == 0 trivially) — refine to: for every successful call to play() when sending either 10 or 11 wei, the observable change in pot equals the exact msg.value sent unless the contract immediately paid out and reset pot to 0; the mutant changes the required accepted msg.value so there exist send amounts that the mutant accepts but the reference rejects, causing a difference in whether the call succeeds and thus observable pot and call success status differ.
change_summary: Change the required msg.value so that play accepts TICKET_AMOUNT + 1 instead of TICKET_AMOUNT, altering when pot is updated and thus observable pot after play.
